name: Opera Australia concession tickets
summary: Concession-priced tickets to most Opera Australia performances in Sydney and Melbourne for full-time Australian students.
who: Full-time Australian students (also full pensioners and children 16 and under).
how: Bring your ID to the box office; proof of eligibility is required for collection.
catches: The page does not state concession prices.
Opera Australia also has an under-35 sign-up with discounted tickets; no price stated.

evidence.quote: for full Australian pensioners, full-time Australian students and children aged 16 years and under
Concession pricing is available for most performances (excluding Saturday evenings)
